Produces a reference to a talk page on this wiki.
== Usage ==
<pre>{{cite talk|:Main Page}}</pre>
<pre>{{cite talk|Talk:Main Page}}</pre>
Links to [[Talk:Main Page]]: {{cite talk|:Main Page}} {{cite talk|Talk:Main Page}}

Links without a namespace specified use the talk namespace corresponding to the current namespace.
<pre>{{cite talk|DF2012:Cat}}</pre>
Links to [[DF2012 talk:Cat]]: {{cite talk|DF2012:Cat}}

<pre>{{cite talk|Quality}}</pre>
Links to [[Template talk:Quality]]: {{cite talk|Quality}}
